product_overview: Prisma is a web application for gabinete operations, combining executive dashboarding, official and communication calendars, briefing management, and field expense reporting. It supports authenticated internal users with role- and module-based access control on top of Supabase.
core_goals: Sign in to access the internal portal and role-based workspace
Review executive indicators and jump to operational modules
Manage the official agenda with manual events and synchronized items
Plan, claim, and filter communication tasks and publications
Create, edit, and print official briefings
Record field activities and expenses for accountability

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with email and password to enter the portal.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated portal redirected to the appropriate workspace
Navigate to /login -> Fill in invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See validation error messages

features.name: Executive KPI Dashboard
features.description: View cabinet-wide indicators and access quick actions to operational modules.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /dashboard -> View active member count and active unit identifier -> View monthly expense, official calendar, and field activity indicators -> Open a quick action -> Arrive at the selected module

features.name: Assessor Activity Logging
features.description: Track field activities and expenses, manage records, and produce a printable agenda report.
user_flows: Sign in as an assessor -> Navigate to /agenda -> Review past activity records -> Start a new activity entry -> Fill in category, date, resolution description, and expense information -> Save the record -> See the new entry in the list
Sign in as an assessor -> Navigate to /agenda -> Open an existing activity record for editing -> Update the details -> Save the changes -> See the updated record
Sign in as an assessor -> Navigate to /agenda -> Choose an activity record for deletion -> Confirm the deletion -> See the record removed from the list
Sign in as an assessor -> Navigate to /agenda -> Request a printable agenda report -> See a print-ready version of the agenda

features.name: Communication Claiming Board
features.description: Browse communication tasks, filter them by editorial criteria, and claim production roles.
user_flows: Sign in -> Navigate to /agenda-comunicacao -> Browse communication tasks -> Filter tasks by media format or theme -> See the task list update
Sign in -> Navigate to /agenda-comunicacao -> Browse an available task -> Claim a production role such as captacao, edicao, texto, or publicacao -> See the role assigned to the user on that task

features.name: Briefings Management
features.description: Create, edit, list, and print official or standalone briefings.
user_flows: Sign in with briefing access -> Navigate to /briefings -> Review the list of briefings and linked official events -> Open a briefing for editing or create a new one -> Fill in the briefing content and save it -> See the briefing stored in the list
Sign in with briefing access -> Navigate to /briefings -> Open a briefing linked to an official agenda event -> Review or update its details -> Save the changes -> See the updated briefing
Sign in with briefing access -> Navigate to /briefings -> Open the print view for a briefing -> See the official print layout -> Print the briefing
